flashcards.exampleZh: 小时候，我们经常在邻居家周围执行“间谍”任务，但这都是假装的。

flashcards.definition: A paper or cardboard wrapper used to enclose small, flat items, especially letters, for mailing.
flashcards.example: This is the word ENVELOPE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种纸或纸板包装材料，用于封装小而扁平的物品，尤其是信件，以便邮寄。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是信封这个词。

flashcards.definition: An act of stamping the foot, paw or hoof.
flashcards.example: The horse gave two quick stamps and rose up on its hind legs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跺脚、爪子或蹄子的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 马飞快地跺了两下，后腿站了起来。

flashcards.definition: To have a consequence or remnant.
flashcards.example: This is the word LEAVE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 产生后果或残余。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“离开”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A sequence of letters and numbers added to a postal address to aid the sorting and delivery of post / mail.
flashcards.example: This is the word POSTCODE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 添加到邮政地址的一系列字母和数字，以帮助邮件/邮件的分类和投递。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是邮政编码一词。

flashcards.definition: In a natural manner.
flashcards.example: Although he was unused to the situation, he tried to act naturally.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以自然的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 尽管他不习惯这种情况，但他还是尽量表现得自然一些。

flashcards.definition: Having done something a short while ago that distinguishes them as what they are called.
flashcards.example: I met three recent graduates at the conference.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不久前做了一些事情，使它们与众不同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我在会议上遇到了三位应届毕业生。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word soso.

flashcards.definitionZh: 索索这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是索索这个词。

flashcards.definition: A friend, usually of the same sex.
flashcards.example: He's my best mate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朋友，通常是同性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是我最好的伙伴。

flashcards.definition: Someone living in the same house.
flashcards.example: This is the word HOUSEMATE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有人住在同一所房子里。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是HOUSEMATE这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person with whom one shares a flat.
flashcards.example: This is the word FLATMATE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与某人合住一套公寓的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是 FLATMATE 这个词。

flashcards.definition: A student who is in the same class at school.
flashcards.example: Danny and I have been classmates for five years, but I've never spoken to him outside of lessons.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在学校同班的学生。
flashcards.exampleZh: 丹尼和我已经是五年同学了，但课外我从来没有和他说过话。

flashcards.definition: Somebody with whom one works; a coworker.
flashcards.example: This is the word WORKMATE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与某人一起工作的人；一位同事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“WORKMATE”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: To allow to, not to prevent (+ infinitive, but usually without to).
flashcards.example: After he knocked for hours, I decided to let him come in.
flashcards.definitionZh: 允许，而不是阻止（+ 不定式，但通常不带 to）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他敲了几个小时后，我决定让他进来。

flashcards.definition: An opportunity or possibility.
flashcards.example: We had the chance to meet the president last week.
flashcards.definitionZh: 机会或可能性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 上周我们有机会会见了总统。

flashcards.definition: To discharge; to end the employment or service of.
flashcards.example: The company dismissed me after less than a year.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放电；终止雇佣或服务。
flashcards.exampleZh: 不到一年，公司就解雇了我。

flashcards.definition: A place where people behave ruthlessly, unconstrained by law or morality.
flashcards.example: It’s a jungle out there.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人们行为残忍、不受法律或道德约束的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 外面是一片丛林。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word fiftyfifty.
flashcards.example: This is the word fiftyfifty.
flashcards.definitionZh: 五十五这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“五五十”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: Any high-pitched sound similar to the sound made by whistling.
flashcards.example: the whistle of the wind in the trees
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何类似于口哨发出的声音的高音调声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 风在树间的呼啸声

flashcards.definition: To find or search for an animal in the wild with the intention of killing the animal for its meat or for sport.
flashcards.example: Her uncle will go out and hunt for deer, now that it is open season.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在野外寻找或搜索动物，目的是为了获取肉或娱乐而杀死该动物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 现在是开放季节，她叔叔会出去打鹿。

flashcards.definition: Action or fact, as opposed to rhetoric or deliberation.
flashcards.example: I have fulfilled my promise in word and in deed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 行动或事实，而不是言辞或深思熟虑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我已经在言语和行动上兑现了我的承诺。

flashcards.definition: To perform a landing extraordinarily smoothly.
flashcards.example: To my amazement, I greased the landing despite the tricky crosswinds.
flashcards.definitionZh: 异常平稳地执行着陆。
flashcards.exampleZh: 令我惊讶的是，尽管侧风很棘手，我还是在着陆处涂了油。

flashcards.definition: To excise or expunge something from a text.
flashcards.example: The erroneous testimony was scissored from the record.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从文本中删除或删除某些内容。
flashcards.exampleZh: 错误的证词已从记录中删除。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: To cause (something) to cease to be in one's possession or capability due to unfortunate or unknown circumstances, events or reasons.
flashcards.example: He lost his hearing in the explosion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于不幸或未知的情况、事件或原因，导致某人不再拥有或无法拥有（某物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在爆炸中失去了听力。

flashcards.definition: Deserved acknowledgment.
flashcards.example: Give him his due — he is a good actor.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当之无愧的认可。
flashcards.exampleZh: 给予他应得的——他是一个好演员。

flashcards.definitionZh: 当之无愧的认可。
flashcards.exampleZh: 给予他应得的——他是一个好演员。

flashcards.definition: A mother of someone's parent.
flashcards.example: This is the word GRANDMOTHER.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某人父母的母亲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是祖母这个词。

flashcards.definition: A father of someone's parent.
flashcards.example: This is the word GRANDFATHER.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某人父母的父亲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是祖父这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word greatgrandmother.
flashcards.example: This is the word greatgrandmother.
flashcards.definitionZh: 曾祖母这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是曾祖母这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word greatgrandfather.
flashcards.example: This is the word greatgrandfather.
flashcards.definitionZh: 曾祖父这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是曾祖父这个词。

flashcards.definition: Mainly or chiefly; for the most part; usually, generally, on the whole.
flashcards.example: They're mostly good people, although they have made a few mistakes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 主要或主要地；大部分情况下；通常，通常，总的来说。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们大多是好人，尽管他们也犯过一些错误。

flashcards.definition: To the fullest extent or degree.
flashcards.example: They've totally demolished the bank on Main Street.
flashcards.definitionZh: 达到最大的范围或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们完全拆毁了大街上的银行。

flashcards.definition: The decision or judgement of a jury or court; a verdict.
flashcards.example: The court returned a sentence of guilt in the first charge, but innocence in the second.
flashcards.definitionZh: 陪审团或法院的决定或判决；一个判决。
flashcards.exampleZh: 法院对第一项指控作出有罪判决，但对第二项指控作出无罪判决。

flashcards.definition: Neither good nor bad; tolerable, passable, indifferent.
flashcards.example: The dessert was pretty good, but the meal was so-so.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不好也不坏；可以忍受的，尚可的，无所谓的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 甜点还不错，但是饭菜就一般般了。

flashcards.definition: In half: in two equal parts, shares, etc.
flashcards.example: I'll handle production, you handle sales, and we'll split profits fifty-fifty.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一半：分成两等份、份额等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我负责生产，你负责销售，利润我们五五十平分。

flashcards.definition: The mother of one's grandparent.
flashcards.example: This is the word Great-grandmother.
flashcards.definitionZh: 祖父母的母亲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是曾祖母这个词。

flashcards.definition: The father of a grandparent.
flashcards.example: This is the word Great-grandfather.
flashcards.definitionZh: 祖父母的父亲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是曾祖父这个词。

flashcards.definition: To converse or debate concerning a particular topic.
flashcards.example: I don't wish to discuss this further. Let's talk about something else.
flashcards.definitionZh: 就特定主题进行交谈或辩论。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不想进一步讨论这个问题。我们来谈谈别的事情吧。

flashcards.definition: Conversation or debate concerning a particular topic.
flashcards.example: My discussion with the professor was very enlightening.
flashcards.definitionZh: 关于特定主题的对话或辩论。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我与教授的讨论非常有启发性。

flashcards.definition: To debate, disagree or discuss opposing or differing viewpoints.
flashcards.example: He also argued for stronger methods to be used against China.
flashcards.definitionZh: 辩论、不同意或讨论相反或不同的观点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他还主张对中国采取更强硬的手段。

flashcards.definition: A value, or reference to a value, passed to a function.
flashcards.example: Parameters are like labeled fillable blanks used to define a function whereas arguments are passed to a function when calling it, filling in those blanks.
flashcards.definitionZh: 传递给函数的值或对值的引用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 参数就像用于定义函数的标记可填充空白，而参数在调用函数时传递给函数，填充这些空白。

flashcards.definition: A verbal dispute or heated argument.
flashcards.example: We got into a silly quarrel about what food to order.
flashcards.definitionZh: 言语争执或激烈争论。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们为了点什么食物发生了一场愚蠢的争吵。

flashcards.definition: A strong feeling of displeasure, hostility or antagonism towards someone or something, usually combined with an urge to harm.
flashcards.example: You need to control your anger.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对某人或某事产生强烈的不满、敌意或对抗情绪，通常伴有伤害的冲动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你需要控制你的愤怒。

flashcards.definition: Rational thinking (or the capacity for it); the cognitive faculties, collectively, of conception, judgment, deduction and intuition.
flashcards.example: Mankind should develop reason above all other virtues.
flashcards.definitionZh: 理性思考（或理性思考的能力）；概念、判断、演绎和直觉等认知能力的总称。
flashcards.exampleZh: 人类应该发展理性高于一切其他美德。

flashcards.definition: A frequent, routine visitor to an establishment.
flashcards.example: Bartenders usually know their regulars by name.
flashcards.definitionZh: 经常光顾某个机构的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 调酒师通常都知道常客的名字。

flashcards.definition: A party, celebration, social function.
flashcards.example: We’re having a bit of a do on Saturday to celebrate my birthday.
flashcards.wordZh: 做些什么以改进或提高目前
flashcards.definitionZh: 聚会、庆典、社交活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 周六我们会做一些事情来庆祝我的生日。

flashcards.definition: A strong wind.
flashcards.example: We're having a bit of a blow this afternoon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一阵强风。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天下午我们受到了一点打击。

flashcards.definition: A disturbance or uproar.
flashcards.example: to raise, or kick up, a dust
flashcards.definitionZh: 骚乱或骚乱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 扬起或扬起灰尘

flashcards.definition: To sprinkle with powder, or as if with powder.
flashcards.example: to powder one's hair
flashcards.definitionZh: 撒上粉末，或像撒上粉末一样。
flashcards.exampleZh: 搽粉

flashcards.definition: To gather together; amass.
flashcards.example: Suzanne collected all the papers she had laid out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 聚集在一起；积累。
flashcards.exampleZh: 苏珊娜收集了她摆好的所有文件。

flashcards.definition: The front part of the head of a human or other animal, featuring the eyes, nose and mouth, and the surrounding area.
flashcards.example: That girl has a pretty face.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人类或其他动物头部的前部，包括眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴以及周围区域。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那个女孩有一张漂亮的脸。

flashcards.definition: (gerund) The act of persons or things that meet.
flashcards.example: Meeting him will be exciting. I enjoy meeting new people.
flashcards.definitionZh: （动名词）相遇的人或事物的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 见到他将会令人兴奋。 我喜欢结识新朋友。

flashcards.definition: (general) A sport played on foot in which teams attempt to get a ball into a goal or zone defended by the other team.
flashcards.example: Roman and medieval football matches were more violent than any modern type of football.
flashcards.definitionZh: （一般）一项徒步运动，球队试图将球带入另一队防守的球门或区域。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗马和中世纪的足球比赛比任何现代足球比赛都更加暴力。

flashcards.definition: Having red as its color.
flashcards.example: The girl wore a red skirt.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以红色为颜色。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那女孩穿着一条红色的裙子。

flashcards.definition: Large movable item(s), usually in a room, which enhance(s) the room's characteristics, functionally or decoratively.
flashcards.example: A chair is furniture. Sofas are also furniture.
flashcards.definitionZh: 大型可移动物品，通常位于房间内，可增强房间的功能或装饰特征。
flashcards.exampleZh: 椅子是家具。沙发也是家具。

flashcards.definition: Material used to create an engineered product.
flashcards.example: This is the word FURNISH.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于制造工程产品的材料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“家具”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Such as one may avail oneself of; capable of being used for the accomplishment of a purpose.
flashcards.example: We have an available candidate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 诸如人们可以利用的；能够用于实现某个目的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们有一个可用的候选人。

flashcards.definition: A human being, whether man, woman or child.
flashcards.example: Humans share common ancestors with other apes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人，无论是男人、女人还是孩子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 人类与其他猿类有共同的祖先。

flashcards.definition: Man-made; of artifice.
flashcards.example: The flowers were artificial, and he thought them rather tacky.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人造;的技巧。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些花是人造的，他觉得它们很俗气。

flashcards.definition: To (cause to) touch lightly or slightly; to come into contact.
flashcards.example: His ball kissed the black into the corner pocket.
flashcards.definitionZh: （导致）轻轻地或轻微地触摸；来接触。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的球将黑色球吻入角袋。

flashcards.definition: Any of several stiff plants of the genus Juncus, or the family Juncaceae, having hollow or pithy stems and small flowers, and often growing in marshes or near water.
flashcards.example: This is the word RUSH.
flashcards.definitionZh: 灯心草属或灯心草科的几种硬质植物的任何一种，具有中空或多髓的茎和小花，通常生长在沼泽地或水边。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“RUSH”这个词。

flashcards.example: Let's discuss how to play if the hero has KK, and there's an ace on board.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当前玩家，尤其是假设的玩家，用于示例和教学目的。比较：小人。不要与英雄召唤混淆。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们来讨论一下，如果英雄有 KK，并且棋盘上有一张 A，该怎么玩。

flashcards.definition: The contents of such a vessel.
flashcards.example: a dish of stew
flashcards.definitionZh: 这样一个容器的内容物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一盘炖菜

flashcards.definition: An act of putting the ball or shuttlecock in play in various games.
flashcards.example: Whose serve is it?
flashcards.definitionZh: 在各种游戏中将球或毽子投入比赛的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 是谁的发球？

flashcards.word: TO BE FOR OR AGAINST SOMETHING
flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: The portion of the upper human appendage, from the shoulder to the wrist and sometimes including the hand.
flashcards.example: She stood with her right arm extended and her palm forward to indicate “Stop!”
flashcards.definitionZh: 人类上肢的部分，从肩膀到手腕，有时包括手。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她站着，伸出右臂，手掌向前，示意“停！”

flashcards.definition: A red fox, small carnivore (Vulpes vulpes), related to dogs and wolves, with red or silver fur and a bushy tail.
flashcards.example: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
flashcards.definitionZh: 红狐，小型食肉动物（Vulpes vulpes），与狗和狼有亲缘关系，有红色或银色的皮毛和浓密的尾巴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 敏捷的棕色狐狸跳过了那只懒狗。

flashcards.example: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
flashcards.definitionZh: 红狐，小型食肉动物（Vulpes vulpes），与狗和狼有亲缘关系，有红色或银色的皮毛和浓密的尾巴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 敏捷的棕色狐狸跳过了那只懒狗。

flashcards.definition: To take possession of (by force, law etc.).
flashcards.example: to seize a ship after libeling
flashcards.definitionZh: 占有（通过武力、法律等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 诽谤后扣押一艘船

flashcards.definition: (mainly Commonwealth) A small bag used by women (or sometimes by men) for carrying various small personal items.
flashcards.example: This is the word HANDBAG.
flashcards.definitionZh: （主要是英联邦）女性（有时男性）使用的小包，用于携带各种小型个人物品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是手袋这个词。

flashcards.definition: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
flashcards.example: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某物分成两块或更多块的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 股骨已完全断裂，因此应该很容易愈合。

flashcards.definition: (often in plural) An amount of money paid to a worker for a specified quantity of work, usually calculated on an hourly basis and expressed in an amount of money per hour.
flashcards.example: Before her promotion, her wages were 20% less.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）支付给工人完成指定工作量的金额，通常按小时计算并以每小时的金额表示。
flashcards.exampleZh: 升职前，她的工资少了20%。

flashcards.definition: A fixed amount of money paid to a worker, usually calculated on a monthly or annual basis, not hourly, as wages. Implies a degree of professionalism and/or autonomy.
flashcards.example: This is the word SALARY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 支付给工人的固定金额，通常按月或按年计算，而不是按小时计算，作为工资。意味着一定程度的专业精神和/或自主权。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“薪水”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of paying.
flashcards.example: This is the word PAYMENT.
flashcards.definitionZh: 付款的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是付款这个词。

flashcards.definition: A declaration of belief, faith or one's opinion, whether genuine or pretended.
flashcards.example: Despite his continued professions of innocence, the court eventually sentenced him to five years.
flashcards.definitionZh: 信仰、信仰或个人观点的宣言，无论是真实的还是假装的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 尽管他继续声称自己无罪，但法院最终判处他五年徒刑。

flashcards.definition: To no extent, in no way.
flashcards.example: I felt none the worse for my recent illness.
flashcards.definitionZh: 无论如何，绝不。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对最近的病并没有感觉更糟。

flashcards.definition: Firm in standing or position; not tottering or shaking; fixed; firm.
flashcards.example: Hold the ladder steady while I go up.
flashcards.wordZh: 稳定的规律的无变化的
flashcards.definitionZh: 立场或位置坚定；不摇晃或摇晃；固定的;公司。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我上去时扶稳梯子。

flashcards.definition: Anything that is seasonal, such as a financial trend, a product for sale, or an employee.
flashcards.example: This is the word SEASONAL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何季节性的事物，例如金融趋势、待售产品或员工。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是季节性这个词。

flashcards.definition: The area by and around the sea; including the beach, promenade or cliffs
flashcards.example: This is the word SEASIDE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 沿海及周边地区；包括海滩、海滨长廊或悬崖
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“SEASIDE”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An artist who paints pictures.
flashcards.example: This is the word PAINTER.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个画画的艺术家。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是画家这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who plays the piano, particularly with skill or as part of an orchestra.
flashcards.example: This is the word PIANIST.
flashcards.definitionZh: 弹钢琴的人，尤其是弹钢琴的人或作为管弦乐队成员弹钢琴的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是钢琴家这个词。

flashcards.definition: One who performs surgery; a doctor who performs operations on people or animals.
flashcards.example: The surgeon refused to operate because the patient was her son.
flashcards.definitionZh: 进行手术的人；对人或动物进行手术的医生。
flashcards.exampleZh: 外科医生拒绝手术，因为病人是她的儿子。

flashcards.definition: A sheet of any substance beaten or rolled until very thin.
flashcards.example: gold leaf
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何物质的薄片，被打碎或滚压至非常薄。
flashcards.exampleZh: 金箔

flashcards.definition: (also loaf of bread) A block of bread after baking.
flashcards.example: This is the word LOAF.
flashcards.definitionZh: （也指面包）烘烤后的一块面包。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是LOAF这个词。

flashcards.definition: The capacity of such an object
flashcards.example: a shelf of videos
flashcards.definitionZh: 这种物体的容量
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个视频架

flashcards.definition: A vertical (or nearly vertical) rock face.
flashcards.example: This is the word CLIFF.
flashcards.definitionZh: 垂直（或接近垂直）的岩面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是悬崖这个词。

flashcards.definition: (in particular) one of the smaller animals of this family, distinguished from a moose or elk
flashcards.example: I wrecked my car after a deer ran across the road.
flashcards.definitionZh: （特别是）这个家族中较小的动物之一，区别于驼鹿或麋鹿
flashcards.exampleZh: 一只鹿跑过马路后，我的车被撞坏了。

flashcards.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.
flashcards.example: There was lots of wood on the beach.
flashcards.definitionZh: 构成树干和树枝中心部分的物质。用作建筑材料、制造各种物品等或用作燃料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 海滩上有很多木头。

flashcards.definition: A speaking or notice of anything, usually in a brief or cursory manner. Used especially in the phrase make mention of.
flashcards.example: This is the word MENTION.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常以简短或粗略的方式谈论或通知任何事情。特别用在短语make提及中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“提及”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (archaic outside of idioms) To count, reckon, or enumerate.
flashcards.example: All told, there were over a dozen.  Can you tell time on a clock?  He had untold wealth.
flashcards.definitionZh: （习语之外的古语）计数、推算或列举。
flashcards.exampleZh: 算起来，有十多个。  你能看钟上的时间吗？  他拥有数不尽的财富。

flashcards.definition: Someone who is associated with another in a common activity or interest.
flashcards.example: This is the word PARTNER.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与他人有共同活动或兴趣的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“伙伴”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (with on or upon or (that + ordinary verb form)) To hold up a claim emphatically.
flashcards.example: I insist that my secretary dresses nicely.
flashcards.definitionZh: （与 on 或 on 或（that + 普通动词形式）） 强调主张某项主张。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我坚持要求我的秘书穿得漂亮。

flashcards.definition: A flat surface with markings for playing a board game.
flashcards.example: Each player starts the game with four counters on the board.
flashcards.wordZh: 木板登船机委员会膳食费用
flashcards.definitionZh: 带有用于玩棋盘游戏的标记的平坦表面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 每个玩家开始游戏时棋盘上有四个计数器。

flashcards.definition: Any of the long boards laid over joists to make a floor.
flashcards.example: This is the word FLOORBOARD.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何长木板都放置在托梁上以形成地板。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是地板这个词。

flashcards.definition: A board, hanging on a wall, on which notices and announcements are posted.
flashcards.example: This is the word NOTICEBOARD.
flashcards.definitionZh: 挂在墙上的一块板，上面张贴着通知和公告。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是布告栏这个词。

flashcards.definition: A large flat surface, finished with black slate or a similar material, that can be written upon with chalk and subsequently erased; a chalkboard.
flashcards.example: This is the word BLACKBOARD.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个大的平坦表面，用黑色石板或类似材料制成，可以用粉笔在其上书写并随后擦除；一块黑板。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“黑板”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The floorlike covering of the horizontal sections, or compartments, of a ship. Small vessels have only one deck; larger ships have two or three decks.
flashcards.example: to swab the deck
flashcards.definitionZh: 船舶水平部分或舱室的类似地板的覆盖物。小型船舶只有一层甲板；较大的船舶有两层或三层甲板。
flashcards.exampleZh: 擦拭甲板

flashcards.definition: A sweep rower that primarily rows with an oar on the port side.
flashcards.example: Each eight has four ports and four starboards.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种主要用左舷桨划船的扫式划船者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 每八艘船都有四个左舷和四个右舷。

flashcards.definition: One who directs; the person in charge of managing a department or directorate (e.g., director of engineering), project, or production (as in a show or film, e.g., film director).
flashcards.example: This is the word DIRECTOR.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一位指挥者；负责管理部门或董事会（例如工程总监）、项目或制作（如演出或电影，例如电影导演）的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是导演这个词。

flashcards.definition: To no extent, in no way.
flashcards.example: I felt none the worse for my recent illness.
flashcards.definitionZh: 无论如何，绝不。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对最近的病并没有感觉更糟。

flashcards.definition: A tabular schedule of events with the times at which they occur, especially times of arrivals and departures
flashcards.example: The timetable has been changed several times since it was first announced.
flashcards.definitionZh: 事件的表格时间表以及事件发生的时间，尤其是到达和离开的时间
flashcards.exampleZh: 自首次公布以来，时间表已多次更改。

flashcards.definition: A written or printed table of information, often forming an annex or appendix to a statute or other regulatory instrument, or to a legal contract.
flashcards.example: schedule of tribes
flashcards.definitionZh: 书面或印刷的信息表，通常构成法规或其他监管文书或法律合同的附件或附录。
flashcards.exampleZh: 部落时间表

flashcards.definition: A sum of money deposited at a bank and subject to withdrawal.
flashcards.example: to keep one's account at the bank.
flashcards.definitionZh: 存入银行并可以提取的一笔钱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在银行保留账户。

flashcards.definition: Tending to match as much text as possible.
flashcards.example: This regular expression performs a greedy match.
flashcards.definitionZh: 倾向于匹配尽可能多的文本。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该正则表达式执行贪婪匹配。

flashcards.definition: To do enough for; to meet the needs of; to fulfill the wishes or requirements of.
flashcards.example: I'm not satisfied with the quality of the food here.
flashcards.definitionZh: 做足够的事；满足以下需求；以满足……的愿望或要求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对这里食物的质量不满意。

flashcards.definition: A plant, especially a cereal, grown to be harvested as food, livestock fodder or fuel or for any other economic purpose.
flashcards.example: the farmer had lots of crops to sell at the market
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种植物，尤其是谷物，其种植目的是作为食物、牲畜饲料或燃料或用于任何其他经济目的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 农民有很多农作物可以在市场上出售

flashcards.definition: Not to have the same traits or characteristics; to be unalike or distinct.
flashcards.example: These shoes only differ from those ones in having slightly longer laces.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不具有相同的特征或特征；变得不同或不同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些鞋与那些鞋的唯一区别在于鞋带稍长。

flashcards.definition: (usually in the plural) A private lesson.
flashcards.example: If you want to learn ballet, consider taking privates.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）私人课程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果你想学习芭蕾舞，可以考虑参加私人舞蹈。

flashcards.definition: (usually followed by "with," but also sometimes "would" or "might," especially in finance) In some manner or degree; in part; partly. See also what with
flashcards.example: The market will calculate these higher risks in their funding costs what might result in higher lending rates.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常后面跟“with”，但有时也用“would”或“might”，尤其是在金融领域）以某种方式或程度；部分；部分。另请参阅与什么
flashcards.exampleZh: 市场将在其融资成本中计算这些较高的风险，这可能会导致更高的贷款利率。

flashcards.definition: (relative) Used to refer to a previously mentioned person or people.
flashcards.example: He's a person with whom I work. (defining)
flashcards.definitionZh: （亲戚） 用于指代前面提到的一个或多个人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是和我一起工作的人。 （定义）

flashcards.definition: (interrogative) That or those of whom or belonging to whom.
flashcards.example: Several people have lost their suitcases. Whose have you found?
flashcards.definitionZh: （疑问）那个或那些人的或属于谁的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有几个人丢了行李箱。你找到谁的了？

flashcards.definition: An attempt to find something.
flashcards.example: With only five minutes until we were meant to leave, the search for the keys started in earnest.
flashcards.definitionZh: 试图找到一些东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 距离我们离开还有五分钟，寻找钥匙的工作就正式开始了。

flashcards.definition: (sometimes attributive) Something which supports.
flashcards.example: Don't move that beam! It's a support for the whole platform.
flashcards.definitionZh: （有时是定语）支持的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 别动那根横梁！这是对整个平台的支持。

flashcards.definition: Concerning religion.
flashcards.example: It is the job of this court to rule on legal matters. We do not consider religious issues.
flashcards.definitionZh: 关于宗教。
flashcards.exampleZh: 本法院的职责是就法律事务作出裁决。我们不考虑宗教问题。

flashcards.definition: (relative) Used to refer to a previously mentioned person or people.
flashcards.example: He's a person with whom I work. (defining)
flashcards.definitionZh: （亲戚） 用于指代前面提到的一个或多个人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是和我一起工作的人。 （定义）

flashcards.definition: To announce one’s support, choice, opinion, etc.
flashcards.example: He declared him innocent.
flashcards.definitionZh: 宣布自己的支持、选择、意见等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他宣布他无罪。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word redhanded.
flashcards.example: This is the word redhanded.
flashcards.definitionZh: 红手这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是赤手空拳这个词。

flashcards.definition: One who is innocent, especially a young child.
flashcards.example: The slaughter of the innocents was a significant event in the New Testament.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个无辜的人，尤其是一个小孩子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 屠杀无辜者是新约中的一件重大事件。

flashcards.definition: A stimulant, such as amphetamine, that increases energy and decreases appetite.
flashcards.example: This is the word UPPER.
flashcards.wordZh: 社会地位较高的大写位置较高的
flashcards.definitionZh: 兴奋剂，例如安非他明，可以增加能量并降低食欲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是单词“UPPER”。

flashcards.definition: A centre, midpoint.
flashcards.example: The middle of a circle is the point which has the same distance to every point of circle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 中心，中点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 圆的中点是到圆各点距离相等的点。

flashcards.definition: The incidental or subsidiary calculations performed in solving an overall problem.
flashcards.example: Be sure to check your working.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在解决整体问题时进行的附带或辅助计算。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一定要检查你的工作。

flashcards.definition: A group, collection, category or set sharing characteristics or attributes.
flashcards.example: Often used to imply membership of a large class.
flashcards.definitionZh: 共享特征或属性的群体、集合、类别或集合。
flashcards.exampleZh: 通常用来暗示一个大阶级的成员资格。

flashcards.definition: A long-standing group of people sharing cultural aspects such as language, dress, norms of behavior and artistic forms.
flashcards.example: This society has been known for centuries for its colorful clothing and tight-knit family structure.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个长期存在的群体，在语言、服饰、行为规范和艺术形式等方面有着共同的文化。
flashcards.exampleZh: 几个世纪以来，这个社会以其色彩缤纷的服装和紧密的家庭结构而闻名。

flashcards.definition: The nobility, or the hereditary ruling class.
flashcards.example: This is the word ARISTOCRACY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 贵族，或者世袭的统治阶级。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“贵族”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person involved in the ownership or management of an industrial enterprise.
flashcards.example: This is the word INDUSTRIALIST.
flashcards.definitionZh: 参与工业企业的所有权或管理的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是工业家这个词。

flashcards.definition: An actual event, situation, or fact.
flashcards.example: For a change, in this case, he was telling the truth.
flashcards.wordZh: 情形状况这儿指大小写
flashcards.definitionZh: 实际事件、情况或事实。
flashcards.exampleZh: 相比之下，在这种情况下，他说的是实话。

flashcards.definition: Situated close to, or even below, the ground or another normal reference plane; not high or lofty.
flashcards.example: a low wall  a low shelf
flashcards.wordZh: 降低放低此处专指小写
flashcards.definitionZh: 位于地面或其他法线参考平面附近甚至下方；不高也不崇高。
flashcards.exampleZh: 矮墙 矮架子

flashcards.definition: An increase in wages or salary; a rise (UK).
flashcards.example: The boss gave me a raise.
flashcards.definitionZh: 工资或薪水的增加；上升（英国）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 老板给我加薪了。

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: A structure built for commemorative or symbolic reasons, or as a memorial; a commemoration.
flashcards.example: There is a monument on the town green to the soldiers who died in World War I.
flashcards.definitionZh: 出于纪念或象征原因或作为纪念而建造的结构；一个纪念。
flashcards.exampleZh: 镇上的绿地上有一座纪念碑，纪念在第一次世界大战中阵亡的士兵。

flashcards.definition: Recognition of importance or value; respect; veneration (of someone, usually for being morally upright or successful)
flashcards.example: The crowds gave the returning general much honor and praise.
flashcards.definitionZh: 承认重要性或价值；尊重;尊敬（对某人的尊敬，通常是因为道德正直或成功）
flashcards.exampleZh: 群众对归来的将军给予了极大的尊敬和赞扬。

flashcards.definition: A three-dimensional work of art, usually representing a person or animal, usually created by sculpting, carving, molding, or casting.
flashcards.example: This is the word STATUE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 三维艺术作品，通常代表人或动物，通常通过雕刻、雕刻、模制或铸造而创作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是雕像这个词。

flashcards.definition: (grammar, of a verb) Taking a direct object or objects.
flashcards.example: The English verb "to notice" is a transitive verb, because we say things like "She noticed a problem".
flashcards.definitionZh: （动词语法）采用一个或多个直接宾语。
flashcards.exampleZh: 英语动词“to note”是及物动词，因为我们说“她注意到了一个问题”。

flashcards.definition: An attitude of consideration or high regard
flashcards.example: He is an intellectual giant, and I have great respect for him.
flashcards.definitionZh: 考虑或高度尊重的态度
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是一位知识巨人，我非常尊敬他。

flashcards.definition: To reject, turn down.
flashcards.example: He scorned her romantic advances.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要拒绝，就拒绝。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他蔑视她的浪漫追求。

flashcards.definition: A distinguished or eminent person
flashcards.example: This is the word WORTHY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 杰出或杰出的人
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“值得”这个词。

flashcards.definition: That which limits the extent of anything; limit, extremity, bound, boundary.
flashcards.example: "Alright, look...we can spend the holidays with your parents, but this time it will be on my terms."
flashcards.definitionZh: 限制事物范围的事物；限制，极端，界线，界线。
flashcards.exampleZh: “好吧，你看……我们可以和你父母一起过节，不过这一次由我来决定。”

flashcards.definition: To participate in religious ceremonies.
flashcards.example: We worship at the church down the road.
flashcards.definitionZh: 参加宗教仪式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们在路边的教堂做礼拜。

flashcards.definition: Domesticated bovine animals (cows, bulls, steers etc).
flashcards.example: Do you want to raise cattle?
flashcards.definitionZh: 驯养的牛类动物（奶牛、公牛、阉牛等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你想养牛吗？

flashcards.definition: A man who tends free-range cattle, especially in the American West.
flashcards.example: This is the word COWBOY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 照顾散养牛的人，尤其是在美国西部。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是牛仔这个词。

flashcards.definition: The third season of the year; autumn; fall.
flashcards.example: Harvest is usually very damp and rainy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一年中的第三个季节；秋天;落下。
flashcards.exampleZh: 收获时通常非常潮湿多雨。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word motherinlaw.
flashcards.example: This is the word motherinlaw.
flashcards.definitionZh: 婆婆这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是婆婆这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word fatherinlaw.
flashcards.example: This is the word fatherinlaw.
flashcards.definitionZh: 岳父这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是岳父这个词。

flashcards.definition: A railroad; a railway, as a means of transportation.
flashcards.example: We travelled to the seaside by rail.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一条铁路；铁路，作为一种运输工具。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们乘火车去海边。

flashcards.definition: A fence or barrier consisting of one or more horizontal rails and vertical supports.
flashcards.example: During the war, everyone's railings were taken away to make bombers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由一个或多个水平栏杆和垂直支撑物组成的栅栏或障碍物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 战争期间，大家的栏杆都被拆掉了，用来制造轰炸机。

flashcards.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
flashcards.example: I just got back from my morning run.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跑步、用脚快速移动的动作或实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我刚刚晨跑回来。

flashcards.definition: The process of keeping (something or someone) safe.
flashcards.example: Raincoats give protection from rain.
flashcards.definitionZh: 保证（某物或某人）安全的过程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 雨衣可以防雨。

flashcards.definition: An accessible structure extending from a building, especially outside a window.
flashcards.example: This is the word BALCONY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从建筑物延伸出来的无障碍结构，尤其是窗户外面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是阳台这个词。

flashcards.definition: Showing clear evidence of guilt; in the act of wrongdoing.
flashcards.example: This is the word Red-handed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 出示明确的有罪证据；在不法行为中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是红手这个词。

flashcards.definition: The mother of one's spouse.
flashcards.example: This is the word Mother-in-law.
flashcards.definitionZh: 配偶的母亲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是婆婆这个词。

flashcards.definition: One's spouse's father.
flashcards.example: This is the word Father-in-law.
flashcards.definitionZh: 配偶的父亲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是岳父这个词。

flashcards.definition: The fact of knowing about something; general understanding or familiarity with a subject, place, situation etc.
flashcards.example: His knowledge of Iceland was limited to what he'd seen on the Travel Channel.
flashcards.definitionZh: 了解某事的事实；对主题、地点、情况等的一般理解或熟悉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他对冰岛的了解仅限于在旅游频道上看到的内容。

flashcards.definition: Movement or advancement through a series of events, or points in time; development through time.
flashcards.example: Testing for the new antidote is currently in progress.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过一系列事件或时间点的运动或进步；随着时间的推移而发展。
flashcards.exampleZh: 新解毒剂的测试目前正在进行中。

flashcards.definition: A distinct physical object.
flashcards.example: Tweezers are great for manipulating small items.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个独特的物理对象。
flashcards.exampleZh: 镊子非常适合操作小物品。

flashcards.definition: A comprehensive reference work (often spanning several printed volumes) with articles (usually arranged in alphabetical order, or sometimes arranged by category) on a range of subjects, sometimes general, sometimes limited to a particular field.
flashcards.example: His life's work was a four-volume encyclopedia of aviation topics.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一本综合参考书（通常跨越几卷印刷册），其中包含有关一系列主题的文章（通常按字母顺序排列，有时按类别排列），有时是一般性的，有时仅限于特定领域。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他一生的工作是一部四卷本的航空主题百科全书。

flashcards.definition: To have a certain mass.

flashcards.definition: Any condition, circumstance, opportunity or means, particularly favorable to success, or to any desired end.
flashcards.example: The enemy had the advantage of a more elevated position.
flashcards.definitionZh: 特别有利于成功或任何期望的目的的任何条件、情况、机会或手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 敌人拥有位置较高的优势。

flashcards.definition: A weakness or undesirable characteristic; a con.
flashcards.example: The disadvantage to owning a food processor is that you have to store it somewhere.
flashcards.definitionZh: 弱点或不良特征；一个骗局。
flashcards.exampleZh: 拥有食品加工机的缺点是您必须将其存放在某个地方。

flashcards.definition: To have a certain mass.
flashcards.example: I mass 70 kilograms.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要有一定的质量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我体重70公斤。

flashcards.definition: The act of producing, making or creating something.
flashcards.example: The widget making machine is being used for production now.
flashcards.definitionZh: 生产、制作或创造某物的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该小部件制造机现已投入生产。

flashcards.definition: A commodity offered for sale.
flashcards.example: That store offers a variety of products.  We've got to sell a lot of product by the end of the month.
flashcards.definitionZh: 供出售的商品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那家商店提供各种产品。  我们必须在月底之前卖出很多产品。

flashcards.definition: (usually pluralized) Something which has exactly the same properties as something else.
flashcards.example: This is the word IDENTICAL.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）与其他事物具有完全相同属性的事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“相同”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Level of excellence.
flashcards.example: Quality of life is usually determined by health, education, and income.
flashcards.definitionZh: 卓越水平。
flashcards.exampleZh: 生活质量通常由健康、教育和收入决定。

flashcards.definition: The blow that drives the shuttle, used in calculating the speed of a loom (in picks per minute); hence, in describing the fineness of a fabric, a weft thread.
flashcards.example: so many picks to an inch
flashcards.definitionZh: 驱动梭子的打击，用于计算织布机的速度（以每分钟纬纱为单位）；因此，在描述织物的细度时，用的是纬线。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一英寸有这么多选择

flashcards.definition: The fruit of the date palm, Phoenix dactylifera, somewhat in the shape of an olive, containing a soft, sweet pulp and enclosing a hard kernel.
flashcards.example: We made a nice cake from dates.
flashcards.definitionZh: 枣椰树（Phoenix dactylifera）的果实，有点像橄榄的形状，含有柔软、甜的果肉，并包裹着坚硬的果仁。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们用枣做了一个漂亮的蛋糕。

flashcards.definition: The collection of words a person knows and uses.
flashcards.example: My Russian vocabulary is very limited.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人知道和使用的单词的集合。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的俄语词汇量非常有限。

flashcards.definition: To stop (an outcome); to keep from (doing something).
flashcards.example: I brush my teeth regularly to prevent them from turning yellow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 停止（结果）；避免（做某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我定期刷牙以防止牙齿变黄。

flashcards.definition: Any similar hollow, cylindrical object.
flashcards.example: Replace the drum unit of your printer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何类似的空心圆柱形物体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 更换打印机的硒鼓单元。

flashcards.definition: Any place of shelter.
flashcards.example: The neighborhood is a well-known harbor for petty thieves.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何避难所。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该街区是著名的小偷窝点。

flashcards.definition: A look at something to satisfy one's curiosity.
flashcards.example: I might wander down to the construction site for a nosy at what they're building.
flashcards.definitionZh: 看一些东西来满足自己的好奇心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我可能会去建筑工地闲逛，看看他们正在建造什么。

flashcards.definition: Belonging to males; typically used by males.
flashcards.example: “John”, “Paul” and “Jake” are masculine names.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于男性；通常由男性使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: “约翰”、“保罗”和“杰克”是男性名字。

flashcards.definition: Belonging to females; typically used by females.
flashcards.example: Mary, Elizabeth, and Edith are feminine names.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于女性；通常由女性使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 玛丽、伊丽莎白和伊迪丝都是女性名字。

flashcards.definition: The single deity of various monotheistic religions, especially the deity of Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.
flashcards.example: Dawn believes in God, but Willow believes in multiple gods and goddesses.
flashcards.definitionZh: 各种一神教的单一神，特别是犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教的神。
flashcards.exampleZh: 黎明相信上帝，但威洛相信多个男神和女神。

flashcards.definition: A female deity.
flashcards.example: This is the word GODDESS.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一位女性神。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是女神这个词。

flashcards.definition: Someone who is preeminent in their field; a great person.
flashcards.example: He is a prince among men.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在自己的领域中出类拔萃的人；一个伟大的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是人间的王子。

flashcards.definition: The wife of a prince; the female ruler of a principality.
flashcards.example: Princess Grace was the Princess of Monaco.
flashcards.definitionZh: 王子的妻子；公国的女性统治者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 格蕾丝王妃是摩纳哥王妃。

flashcards.definition: A son of one's sibling, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law; either a son of one's brother (fraternal nephew) or a son of one's sister (sororal nephew).
flashcards.example: This is the word NEPHEW.
flashcards.definitionZh: 兄弟姐妹、姐夫或嫂子的儿子；兄弟的儿子（兄弟侄子）或姐妹的儿子（姐妹侄子）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是侄子这个词。

flashcards.definition: A daughter of one’s sibling, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law; either the daughter of one's brother ("fraternal niece"), or of one's sister ("sororal niece").
flashcards.example: My niece just celebrated her 15th birthday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 兄弟姐妹、姐夫或嫂子的女儿；兄弟的女儿（“兄弟侄女”），或姐妹的女儿（“姐妹侄女”）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的侄女刚刚庆祝了她的 15 岁生日。

flashcards.definition: A person who owns and rents land such as a house, apartment, or condo.
flashcards.example: This is the word LANDLORD.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拥有并租赁土地（例如房屋、公寓或公寓）的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是房东这个词。

flashcards.definition: A female landlord.
flashcards.example: This is the word LANDLADY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 是个女房东。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“LANDLADY”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A man whose spouse has died (and who has not remarried); masculine of widow.
flashcards.example: This is the word WIDOWER.
flashcards.definitionZh: 配偶去世（且未再婚）的男子；寡妇的男性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是鳏夫这个词。

flashcards.definition: A woman whose spouse has died (and who has not remarried); feminine of widower.
flashcards.example: This is the word WIDOW.
flashcards.definitionZh: 配偶去世（且未再婚）的女性；鳏夫的女性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是寡妇这个词。

flashcards.definition: A prearranged social activity (function, etc.)
flashcards.example: I went to an event in San Francisco last week.
flashcards.definitionZh: 预先安排的社交活动（功能等）
flashcards.exampleZh: 上周我参加了旧金山的一个活动。

flashcards.definition: Of or pertaining to high levels of activity; having many memorable events.
flashcards.example: With the number of drunken revellers on the streets it could hardly fail to be an eventful night.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于或与高水平活动有关的；有许多难忘的事件。
flashcards.exampleZh: 由于街上醉酒狂欢的人数众多，这注定是一个多事之夜。

flashcards.definition: Monotonous; lacking significant or noteworthy events
flashcards.example: This is the word UNEVENTFUL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 单调;缺乏重大或值得注意的事件
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“平淡无奇”这个词。

flashcards.definition: That which affects one’s welfare or happiness. A matter of interest to someone. The adposition before the matter of interest is usually over, about or for.
flashcards.example: Judy's eyes filled with concern as she listened to the news report.
flashcards.definitionZh: 影响一个人的福利或幸福的事物。某人感兴趣的事情。感兴趣的事物之前的介词通常是 over、about 或 for。
flashcards.exampleZh: 朱迪听着新闻报道，眼里充满了担忧。

flashcards.definition: To extol or honour in a solemn manner.
flashcards.example: to celebrate the name of the Most High
flashcards.definitionZh: 以庄严的方式颂扬或尊敬。
flashcards.exampleZh: 庆祝至高者的名字

flashcards.definition: The formal performance of a solemn rite, such as Christian sacrament.
flashcards.example: This is the word CELEBRATION.
flashcards.definitionZh: 庄严仪式的正式表演，例如基督教圣礼。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“庆祝”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Things that are new.
flashcards.example: Out with the old, in with the new.
flashcards.definitionZh: 新的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 淘汰旧的，引进新的。

flashcards.definition: The direction opposed to the pull of gravity.
flashcards.example: Up is a good way to go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与重力方向相反的方向。
flashcards.exampleZh: 向上是一个好方法。

flashcards.definition: A means of exit, escape, reprieve, etc.
flashcards.example: They wrote the law to give those organizations an out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 退出、逃脱、缓刑等的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们制定了法律来给这些组织一个机会。

flashcards.definition: Being in the basic form; showing its essence.
flashcards.example: Don’t mind him being grumpy. That’s the essential Fred.
flashcards.definitionZh: 处于基本形式；展现其本质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 别介意他脾气暴躁。这就是弗雷德的本质。

flashcards.definition: To have a certain mass.
flashcards.example: I mass 70 kilograms.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要有一定的质量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我体重70公斤。

flashcards.definition: Things that are new.
flashcards.example: Out with the old, in with the new.
flashcards.definitionZh: 新的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 淘汰旧的，引进新的。

flashcards.definition: An object, a member of a group or class.
flashcards.example: a sales article
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个对象，一个组或类的成员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 销售文章

flashcards.definition: Capable of being counted; having a quantity.
flashcards.example: This is the word COUNTABLE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 能够被计算；有数量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“可数”这个词。

flashcards.definition: So many as to be incapable of being counted.
flashcards.example: The reasons for our failure were as uncountable as the grains of sand on a beach.
flashcards.definitionZh: 多到无法计数。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们失败的原因就像海滩上的沙粒一样数不胜数。

flashcards.definition: A contemptible or devious being.
flashcards.example: Don't try to run away, you little worm!
flashcards.definitionZh: 卑鄙或狡诈的存在。
flashcards.exampleZh: 别想逃跑，你这个小虫子！

flashcards.definition: Any of various caterpillars of moths that produce silk cocoons, especially Bombyx mori, the source of most commercial silk.
flashcards.example: This is the word SILKWORM.
flashcards.definitionZh: 产生丝茧的各种蛾毛虫，尤其是家蚕，它是大多数商业丝绸的来源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是蚕这个词。

flashcards.definition: A fine fiber excreted by the silkworm or other arthropod (such as a spider).
flashcards.example: The thread made of silk was barely visible.
flashcards.definitionZh: 蚕或其他节肢动物（如蜘蛛）分泌的细纤维。
flashcards.exampleZh: 丝线几乎看不见。

flashcards.definition: To remove the limbs from (an animal or tree).
flashcards.example: They limbed the felled trees before cutting them into logs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 除去（动物或树木）的四肢。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们将砍伐的树木砍伐成树枝，然后将其砍成原木。

flashcards.definition: A substance that is harmful or lethal to a living organism.
flashcards.example: We used a poison to kill the weeds.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对生物体有害或致命的物质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们用毒药来杀死杂草。

flashcards.definition: A large, naturally-occurring cavity formed underground or in the face of a cliff or a hillside.
flashcards.example: We found a cave on the mountainside where we could take shelter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 地下或悬崖或山坡上自然形成的大型空洞。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们在山腰上找到了一个可以避难的山洞。

flashcards.definition: Any of the flying mammals of the order Chiroptera, usually small and nocturnal, insectivorous or frugivorous.
flashcards.example: This is the word BAT.
flashcards.definitionZh: 翼手目任何会飞的哺乳动物，通常体型较小，夜行性，食虫或食果。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是BAT这个词。

flashcards.definition: To be entitled to, as a result of past actions; to be worthy to have.
flashcards.example: After playing so well, the team really deserved their win.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于过去的行为而有权获得；值得拥有。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在打得如此出色之后，球队确实配得上这场胜利。

flashcards.definition: Done or occurring often; common.
flashcards.example: I am a frequent visitor to that city.
flashcards.definitionZh: 做过或经常发生；常见的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我是那个城市的常客。

flashcards.definition: Done or occurring often; common.
flashcards.example: I am a frequent visitor to that city.
flashcards.definitionZh: 做过或经常发生；常见的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我是那个城市的常客。

flashcards.definition: At frequent intervals.
flashcards.example: This question arises frequently.
flashcards.definitionZh: 经常间隔。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个问题经常出现。

flashcards.definition: To pull toward without touching.
flashcards.example: A magnet attracts iron filings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉向但不接触。
flashcards.exampleZh: 磁铁会吸引铁屑。

flashcards.definition: Mental focus.
flashcards.example: Please direct your attention to the following words.
flashcards.definitionZh: 精神集中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请大家注意以下几句话。

flashcards.definition: The tendency to attract.
flashcards.example: The Moon is held in its orbit by the attraction of the Earth's gravity.
flashcards.wordZh: 吸引力有吸引力的地方
flashcards.definitionZh: 吸引的倾向。
flashcards.exampleZh: 月球在地球引力的作用下保持在其轨道上。

flashcards.definition: Having the power of charming or alluring by agreeable qualities; enticing.
flashcards.example: That's a very attractive offer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 因令人愉快的品质而具有迷人或诱惑的力量；诱人的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是一个非常有吸引力的报价。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word goodlooking.
flashcards.example: This is the word goodlooking.
flashcards.definitionZh: 好看这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是好看这个词。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: Very bad (at something); unskilled, incompetent.
flashcards.example: He's good at some sports, like tennis, but he's just miserable at football.
flashcards.definitionZh: （在某事上）非常糟糕；不熟练、无能。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他擅长某些运动，比如网球，但他不擅长足球。

flashcards.definition: A person's internal state of being and involuntary physiological response to an object or a situation, based on or tied to physical state and sensory data.
flashcards.example: This is the word EMOTION.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人的内部存在状态以及对物体或情况的无意识生理反应，基于或依赖于物理状态和感官数据。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“情感”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Of or relating to the emotions.
flashcards.example: emotional crisis
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于或与情绪有关的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 情感危机

flashcards.definition: Physically attractive (of a person).
flashcards.example: This is the word Good-looking.
flashcards.definitionZh: （人的）外表上有吸引力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“好看”这个词。

flashcards.definition: In the first place; before anything else; first.
flashcards.example: This is the word FIRSTLY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 首先;首先；第一的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“首先”这个词。

flashcards.definition: In the second place.
flashcards.example: This is the word SECONDLY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 其次。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是第二个词。

flashcards.definition: The part of the body of an animal or human which contains the brain, mouth and main sense organs.
flashcards.example: Be careful when you pet that dog on the head; it may bite.
flashcards.definitionZh: 动物或人类身体的一部分，包含大脑、口腔和主要感觉器官。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当你抚摸那只狗的头时要小心；它可能会咬人。

flashcards.definition: (usually academic) To review materials already learned in order to make sure one does not forget them, usually in preparation for an examination.
flashcards.example: I need to study my biology notes.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常是学术性的）复习已经学过的材料，以确保不会忘记它们，通常是为了准备考试。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我需要学习我的生物笔记。

flashcards.definition: A formalized choice on matters of administration or other democratic activities
flashcards.example: One occasion indicative votes were used was in 2003 when MPs were presented with seven different options on how to reform the House of Lords.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对行政事务或其他民主活动的正式选择
flashcards.exampleZh: 一次使用指示性投票是在 2003 年，当时议员们就如何改革上议院提出了七种不同的选择。

flashcards.definition: A person (usually a woman) who takes care of other people’s young.
flashcards.example: They hired a nurse to care for their young boy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 照顾别人孩子的人（通常是女性）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们雇了一名护士来照顾他们的小男孩。

flashcards.definition: Something which educates and nurtures.
flashcards.example: Commerce is the nursery of seamen.
flashcards.definitionZh: 教育和培育的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 商业是海员的摇篮。

flashcards.definition: The state of having no job; joblessness.
flashcards.example: Unemployment made Jack depressed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有工作的状态；失业。
flashcards.exampleZh: 失业使杰克心情沮丧。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: The part of Earth which is not covered by oceans or other bodies of water.
flashcards.example: Most insects live on land.
flashcards.definitionZh: 地球上未被海洋或其他水体覆盖的部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大多数昆虫生活在陆地上。

flashcards.definition: To put an object into a place where it will rest; to fix; to set firm.
flashcards.example: Be sure to seat the gasket properly before attaching the cover.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将一个物体放到一个可以休息的地方；修复；坚定。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在安装盖子之前，请务必正确固定垫圈。

flashcards.definition: Repetition of an activity to improve a skill.
flashcards.example: He will need lots of practice with the lines before he performs them.
flashcards.definitionZh: 重复某项活动以提高技能。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在表演之前，他需要大量练习台词。

flashcards.definition: A field of study attempting to exhaustively describe a particular class of constructs.
flashcards.example: Knot theory classifies the mappings of a circle into 3-space.
flashcards.definitionZh: 试图详尽地描述一类特定结构的研究领域。
flashcards.exampleZh: 纽结理论将圆的映射分类为 3 空间。

flashcards.definition: Based on practice or action rather than theory or hypothesis
flashcards.example: Jack didn't get an engineering degree, but has practical knowledge of metalworking.
flashcards.definitionZh: 基于实践或行动而不是理论或假设
flashcards.exampleZh: 杰克没有获得工程学位，但拥有金属加工的实用知识。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: To put (something) down, to rest.
flashcards.example: Set the tray there.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放下（某物），休息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将托盘放在那里。

flashcards.definition: The natural world; that which consists of all things unaffected by or predating human technology, production, and design. (Compare ecosystem.)
flashcards.example: Nature never lies (i.e. tells untruths).
flashcards.definitionZh: 自然世界；由不受人类技术、生产和设计影响或早于人类技术、生产和设计的所有事物组成。 （比较生态系统。）
flashcards.exampleZh: 大自然从不说谎（即说谎）。

flashcards.definition: A human being, whether man, woman or child.
flashcards.example: Humans share common ancestors with other apes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人，无论是男人、女人还是孩子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 人类与其他猿类有共同的祖先。

flashcards.definition: To be in battle or in a rivalry with another for the same thing, position, or reward; to contend
flashcards.example: This is the word COMPETE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为了同样的事物、地位或奖励而与他人进行战斗或竞争；去争
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“竞争”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The action of competing.
flashcards.example: The competition for this job is strong.
flashcards.definitionZh: 竞争的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这份工作的竞争非常激烈。

flashcards.definition: The impetus behind all motion and all activity.
flashcards.example: This is the word ENERGY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 所有运动和所有活动背后的动力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是能量这个词。

flashcards.definition: Making good, thorough, or careful use of resources; not consuming extra. Especially, making good use of time or energy
flashcards.example: An efficient process would automate all the routine work.
flashcards.definitionZh: 良好、彻底或谨慎地利用资源；不额外消耗。尤其是充分利用时间或精力
flashcards.exampleZh: 高效的流程将使所有日常工作自动化。

flashcards.definition: A set of clothes to be worn together, now especially a man's matching jacket and trousers (also business suit or lounge suit), or a similar outfit for a woman.
flashcards.example: Nick hired a navy-blue suit for the wedding.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一套可以一起穿的衣服，现在特别是男士配套的夹克和裤子（也可以是商务套装或休闲套装），或者是女士的类似服装。
flashcards.exampleZh: 尼克为婚礼雇了一套深蓝色西装。

flashcards.definition: Having sufficient or the required properties for a certain purpose or task; appropriate to a certain occasion.
flashcards.example: This is the word SUITABLE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有用于特定目的或任务的足够或所需的属性；适合某种场合。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“适合”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The result or outcome of a cause.
flashcards.example: The effect of the hurricane was a devastated landscape.
flashcards.definitionZh: 原因的结果或结果。
flashcards.exampleZh: 飓风的影响是一片满目疮痍的景象。

flashcards.definition: Fitting its definition precisely.
flashcards.example: a perfect circle
flashcards.definitionZh: 精确地符合其定义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个完美的圆

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: The direct rays, light or warmth of the sun.
flashcards.example: We were warmed by the bright sunshine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 阳光的直射光线、光线或温暖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 明媚的阳光让我们感到温暖。

flashcards.definition: A substance used to polish.
flashcards.example: A good silver polish will remove tarnish easily.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于抛光的物质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 好的银抛光剂可以轻松去除锈迹。

flashcards.definition: The quality or state of being able; capacity to do or of doing something; having the necessary power.
flashcards.example: This phone has the ability to have its software upgraded wirelessly.
flashcards.definitionZh: 能力的品质或状态；做某事或做某事的能力；拥有必要的权力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这款手机能够无线升级软件。

flashcards.definition: A spending or consuming, often a disbursement of funds.
flashcards.example: Buying the car was a big expense, but will be worth it in the long run.
flashcards.definitionZh: 支出或消费，通常是资金的支出。
flashcards.exampleZh: 买车是一笔很大的开支，但从长远来看是值得的。

flashcards.definition: To delay or put off an event, appointment etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word POSTPONE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 推迟或推迟活动、约会等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“推迟”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Emotional pressure suffered by a human being or other animal.
flashcards.example: Go easy on him, he's been under a lot of stress lately.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人类或其他动物遭受的情绪压力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 放心吧，他最近压力很大。

flashcards.definition: Irritating; causing stress.
flashcards.example: This is the word STRESSFUL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 刺激性的；造成压力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“压力”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (temporal location) At a later or succeeding time.
flashcards.example: This is the word AFTERWARDS.
flashcards.definitionZh: （临时位置）稍后或随后的时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“之后”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The person or thing in the first position.
flashcards.example: He was the first to complete the course.
flashcards.definitionZh: 处于第一位的人或物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是第一个完成课程的人。

flashcards.definition: To turn one's consideration (to); to deal with (a task, problem, concern etc.), to look after.
flashcards.example: Secretaries attend to correspondence.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某人的注意力转向（to）；处理（任务、问题、担忧等）、照顾。
flashcards.exampleZh: 秘书负责处理信件。

flashcards.definition: A trader who sells goods in a shop, or by retail, in distinction from one who sells by wholesale, or sells door to door.
flashcards.example: This is the word SHOPKEEPER.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在商店或零售中销售商品的商人，与批发或挨家挨户销售的商人不同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“店主”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of moving; a movement.
flashcards.example: A slight move of the tiller, and the boat will go off course.
flashcards.definitionZh: 移动的行为；一个动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 舵柄轻轻一动，船就会偏离航线。

flashcards.definition: A hole or break caused by tearing.
flashcards.example: A small tear is easy to mend, if it is on the seam.
flashcards.definitionZh: 因撕裂而造成的孔洞或断裂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果是在接缝处，小撕裂很容易修补。

flashcards.definition: To change place.
flashcards.example: This is the word Pass.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要换地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是通行证这个词。

flashcards.definition: Of food, to become bad, sour or rancid; to decay.
flashcards.example: Make sure you put the milk back in the fridge, otherwise it will spoil.
flashcards.definitionZh: 食物变质、变酸或腐臭；腐烂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 确保将牛奶放回冰箱，否则会变质。

flashcards.definition: Of food, to become bad, sour or rancid; to decay.
flashcards.example: Make sure you put the milk back in the fridge, otherwise it will spoil.
flashcards.definitionZh: 食物变质、变酸或腐臭；腐烂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 确保将牛奶放回冰箱，否则会变质。

flashcards.definition: A controlled behaviour; self-control.
flashcards.example: This is the word DISCIPLINE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 受控的行为；自我控制。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是纪律这个词。

flashcards.definition: (by extension) Any strong desire.
flashcards.example: I have a hunger to win.
flashcards.definitionZh: （推而广之）任何强烈的愿望。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我渴望胜利。

flashcards.definition: A configuration enabling a resource to be shared over a network.
flashcards.example: Upload media from the browser or directly to the file share.
flashcards.definitionZh: 允许通过网络共享资源的配置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 从浏览器上传媒体或直接上传到文件共享。

flashcards.definition: Of food, to become bad, sour or rancid; to decay.
flashcards.example: Make sure you put the milk back in the fridge, otherwise it will spoil.
flashcards.definitionZh: 食物变质、变酸或腐臭；腐烂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 确保将牛奶放回冰箱，否则会变质。

flashcards.definition: The act of associating.
flashcards.example: This is the word ASSOCIATION.
flashcards.definitionZh: 关联的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是协会这个词。

flashcards.definition: A type of vehicle designed to move on the ground under its own stored power and intended to carry a driver, a small number of additional passengers, and a very limited amount of other load. A car or motorcar.
flashcards.example: This is the word AUTOMOBILE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种设计为利用自身存储的动力在地面上移动的车辆，旨在搭载一名驾驶员、少量额外乘客和非常有限的其他负载。汽车或汽车。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是汽车这个词。

flashcards.definition: To confuse a quiet, constant state or a calm, continuous flow, in particular: thoughts, actions or liquids.
flashcards.example: A school of fish disturbed the water.
flashcards.definitionZh: 混淆安静、持续的状态或平静、连续的流动，特别是：思想、行动或液体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一群鱼扰乱了水面。

flashcards.definition: To bring to, or direct toward, a common center; to unite more closely; to gather into one body, mass, or force.
flashcards.example: to concentrate rays of light into a focus
flashcards.definitionZh: 带来或直接走向一个共同中心；更加紧密地团结起来；聚集成一个身体、质量或力量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将光线集中到一个焦点

flashcards.definition: The quality of being confident, not afraid or easily intimidated, but without being incautious or inconsiderate.
flashcards.example: It takes a lot of courage to be successful in business.
flashcards.definitionZh: 自信的品质，不害怕或容易被吓倒，但又不粗心或不体贴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 要想在商业上取得成功，需要很大的勇气。

flashcards.definition: Accordance with moral principles; conformity of behaviour or thought with the strictures of morality; good moral conduct.
flashcards.example: Without virtue, there is no freedom.
flashcards.definitionZh: 符合道德原则；行为或思想符合道德规范；良好的道德行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 没有美德，就没有自由。

flashcards.definition: Having or demonstrating undivided and constant support for someone or something.
flashcards.example: This is the word LOYAL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对某人或某事拥有或表现出全心全意和持续的支持。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“忠诚”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The state of being loyal; fidelity.
flashcards.example: This is the word LOYALTY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 忠诚的状态；保真度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是忠诚这个词。

flashcards.definition: A friend, acquaintance, or partner; someone with whom one spends time or keeps company
flashcards.example: His dog has been his trusted companion for the last five years.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朋友、熟人或伙伴；与之共度时光或陪伴的人
flashcards.exampleZh: 过去五年来，他的狗一直是他值得信赖的伴侣。

flashcards.definition: A supernatural being, often but not exclusively without physical form; ghost, fairy, angel.
flashcards.example: A wandering spirit haunts the island.
flashcards.definitionZh: 超自然存在，通常但不完全没有物理形态；幽灵，仙女，天使。
flashcards.exampleZh: 岛上有一个游荡的灵魂。

flashcards.definition: Any spiritual function, office, or affair.
flashcards.example: He assigns supremacy to the pope in spirituals, and to the emperor in temporals. — Lowell.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何精神活动、办公室或事务。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他赋予教皇在圣事上的至高无上权，以及皇帝在世俗上的至高无上权。 ——洛厄尔。

flashcards.definition: Moral badness; wickedness; malevolence; the forces or behaviors that are the opposite or enemy of good.
flashcards.example: Evil lacks spirituality, hence its need for mind control.
flashcards.definitionZh: 道德败坏；邪恶；恶意;与善相反或敌人的力量或行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 邪恶缺乏灵性，因此需要精神控制。

flashcards.definition: A formalization of the idea of the motion of particles in a fluid, as a group action of the real numbers on a set.
flashcards.example: The notion of flow is basic to the study of ordinary differential equations.
flashcards.definitionZh: 流体中粒子运动概念的形式化，作为一组实数的群作用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 流动的概念是常微分方程研究的基础。

flashcards.definition: An event or community gathering, usually staged by a local community, which centers on some theme, sometimes on some unique aspect of the community.
flashcards.example: This is the word FESTIVAL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常由当地社区举办的活动或社区聚会，以某个主题为中心，有时以社区的某些独特方面为中心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“节日”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A very large meal, often of a ceremonial nature.
flashcards.example: We had a feast to celebrate the harvest.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一顿丰盛的晚餐，通常具有仪式性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们举办了一场盛宴来庆祝丰收。

flashcards.definition: To have enough courage (to do something).
flashcards.example: I wouldn't dare argue with my boss.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有足够的勇气（做某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不敢和老板争论。

flashcards.definition: To invite (someone) to take part in a competition.
flashcards.example: We challenged the boys next door to a game of football.
flashcards.definitionZh: 邀请（某人）参加比赛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们向隔壁的男孩们发起了一场足球比赛。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To transport toward somebody/somewhere.
flashcards.example: Waiter, please bring me a single malt whiskey.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）前往某人/某处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 服务员，请给我一杯单一麦芽威士忌。

flashcards.definition: (chiefly law enforcement) A solution; an explanation.
flashcards.example: This is the word SOLVE.
flashcards.definitionZh: （主要是执法部门）解决方案；一个解释。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“解决”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A mechanical or electronic device that performs mathematical calculations.
flashcards.example: This is the word CALCULATOR.
flashcards.definitionZh: 执行数学计算的机械或电子设备。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是计算器这个词。

flashcards.definition: A repair or corrective action.
flashcards.example: That plumber's fix is much better than the first one's.
flashcards.definitionZh: 修理或纠正措施。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那个水管工的修理比第一个好得多。

flashcards.definition: A tool with a heavy head and a handle used for pounding.
flashcards.example: Bobby used a hammer and nails to fix the two planks together
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种带有重头和柄的工具，用于敲击。
flashcards.exampleZh: 鲍比用锤子和钉子将两块木板固定在一起

flashcards.definition: The thin, horny plate at the ends of fingers and toes on humans and some other animals.
flashcards.example: When I'm nervous I bite my nails.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人类和其他一些动物手指和脚趾末端的薄角质板。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当我紧张的时候我会咬指甲。

flashcards.definition: The hard, flat translucent covering near the tip of a human finger, useful for scratching and fine manipulation.
flashcards.example: This is the word FINGERNAIL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 靠近人指尖的坚硬、平坦的半透明覆盖物，可用于刮擦和精细操作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“指甲”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To find fault (with something).
flashcards.example: They criticized him for endangering people's lives.
flashcards.definitionZh: 挑衅（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们批评他危及人们的生命。

flashcards.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.
flashcards.example: This is the word Yard.
flashcards.definitionZh: 毗邻房屋或其他建筑物或（现在特别是）房屋或其他建筑物范围内的通常未开垦的小区域。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“院子”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An area, open to the sky, partially or wholly surrounded by walls or buildings.
flashcards.example: She sat in the courtyard, enjoying the garden.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向天空开放的区域，部分或全部被墙壁或建筑物包围。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她坐在院子里，欣赏着花园里的景色。

flashcards.definition: To surround with a wall, fence, etc.
flashcards.example: to enclose lands
flashcards.definitionZh: 用墙、栅栏等围起来。
flashcards.exampleZh: 圈地

flashcards.definition: (heading) Of time.
flashcards.example: This is the word SPACE.
flashcards.definitionZh: （标题）时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“空间”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To entertain or occupy in a pleasant manner; to stir with pleasing emotions.
flashcards.example: I watch these movies because they amuse me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以愉快的方式娱乐或消遣；激起愉悦的情绪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我看这些电影是因为它们让我开心。

flashcards.definition: Relating to comedy.
flashcards.example: a comic stereotype
flashcards.definitionZh: 与喜剧有关。
flashcards.exampleZh: 喜剧刻板印象

flashcards.definition: To change place.
flashcards.example: This is the word Pass.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要换地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是通行证这个词。

flashcards.definition: (in the plural) Any game using playing cards; a card game.
flashcards.example: He played cards with his friends.
flashcards.definitionZh: （复数）任何使用扑克牌的游戏；一款纸牌游戏。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他和朋友们一起打牌。

flashcards.definition: To delay movement or action until some event or time; to remain neglected or in readiness.
flashcards.example: Wait here until your car arrives.
flashcards.definitionZh: 推迟行动或行动，直到某个事件或时间；保持被忽视或准备就绪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在这里等待，直到你的车到达。

flashcards.definition: Entertainment.
flashcards.example: This is the word AMUSEMENT.
flashcards.definitionZh: 娱乐。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“娱乐”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An activity that one enjoys doing in one's spare time.
flashcards.example: I like to collect stamps from different countries as a hobby.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人在业余时间喜欢做的一项活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我喜欢收集不同国家的邮票作为一种爱好。

flashcards.definition: The art and technology of producing images on photosensitive surfaces, and its digital counterpart.
flashcards.example: This is the word PHOTOGRAPHY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在感光表面及其数字对应物上生成图像的艺术和技术。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是摄影这个词。

flashcards.definition: The state of being well arranged.
flashcards.example: The house is in order; the machinery is out of order.
flashcards.definitionZh: 被安排好的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 房子秩序井然；机器出了故障。

flashcards.definition: A bundle made up and prepared to be carried; especially, a bundle to be carried on the back, but also a load for an animal, a bale.
flashcards.example: The horses carried the packs across the plain.
flashcards.definitionZh: 准备好携带的包裹；特别是，可以背在背上的包裹，也可以是动物的负载，即捆包。
flashcards.exampleZh: 马匹驮着行李穿过平原。

flashcards.definition: To load with a pack
flashcards.example: to pack a horse
flashcards.definitionZh: 装载包
flashcards.exampleZh: 收拾一匹马

flashcards.definition: A large (usually rectangular) piece of luggage used for carrying clothes, and sometimes suits, when travelling.
flashcards.example: This is the word SUITCASE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 旅行时用来携带衣服（有时是西装）的大件（通常是矩形）行李。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“手提箱”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A short version of a garment in a particular size.
flashcards.example: 38 short suits fit me right off the rack.
flashcards.definitionZh: 特定尺码的短版服装。
flashcards.exampleZh: 38 件短裤套装现成的就很适合我。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word tshirt t.
flashcards.example: This is the word tshirt t.
flashcards.definitionZh: T 恤 t 这个词的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是T恤t这个词。

flashcards.definition: Any shrub or small tree that bears thorns, especially a hawthorn.
flashcards.example: the cockspur thorn
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何带刺的灌木或小树，尤其是山楂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 鸡刺

flashcards.definition: A shrub of the genus Rosa, with red, pink, white or yellow flowers.
flashcards.example: This is the word Rose.
flashcards.definitionZh: 蔷薇属灌木，开红色、粉红色、白色或黄色的花。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是玫瑰这个词。

flashcards.definition: To incur, stand, or bear without serious detriment, as an act which might under other circumstances be injurious;—with an auxiliary, as can, could, might, etc.; to be able or rich enough.
flashcards.example: I think we can afford the extra hour it will take.  We can only afford to buy a small car at the moment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 作为在其他情况下可能造成伤害的行为，在没有严重损害的情况下招致、承受或承受；——带有辅助词，如can、could、might等；有能力或足够富有。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我想我们可以承受额外的时间。  我们目前只能买一辆小型汽车。

flashcards.definition: An understanding between entities to follow a specific course of conduct.
flashcards.example: to enter an agreement;  the UK and US negotiators nearing agreement;  he nodded his agreement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 实体之间达成共识以遵循特定的行为方针。
flashcards.exampleZh: 签订协议；  英国和美国谈判代表接近达成协议；  他点头表示同意。

flashcards.definition: A lightweight container, generally round, open at the top, and tapering toward the bottom.
