flashcards.definition: Not being used appropriately; not occupied; (of time) with no, no important, or not much activity.
flashcards.example: My computer hibernates after it has been idle for 30 minutes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 未正确使用；未被占用； （时间）没有、不重要或不多的活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的计算机闲置 30 分钟后就会进入休眠状态。

flashcards.definition: Activity for amusement only, especially among the young.
flashcards.example: Children learn through play.
flashcards.definitionZh: 仅供娱乐的活动，尤其是年轻人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 孩子们通过玩耍来学习。

flashcards.definition: A poetic form with regular meter and a fixed rhyme scheme.
flashcards.example: Restoration literature is well known for its carefully constructed verse.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有规则格律和固定韵律的诗歌形式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 复辟文学以其精心构造的诗句而闻名。

flashcards.definition: A group of singers; singing group who perform together.
flashcards.example: The performance of the chorus was awe-inspiring and exhilarating.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一群歌手；一起表演的歌唱团体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 合唱团的表演震撼人心、振奋人心。

flashcards.definition: To direct words and/or thoughts to God or any higher being, for the sake of adoration, thanks, petition for help, etc.
flashcards.example: Muslims pray in the direction of Mecca.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为了崇拜、感谢、请求帮助等而向上帝或任何更高的存在表达言语和/或思想。
flashcards.exampleZh: 穆斯林朝麦加的方向祈祷。

flashcards.definition: A practice of communicating with one's God.
flashcards.example: Through prayer I ask for God's blessings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与神沟通的一种练习。
flashcards.exampleZh: 通过祈祷，我请求上帝的祝福。

flashcards.definition: A combine harvester
flashcards.example: We can't finish harvesting because our combine is stuck in the mud.
flashcards.definitionZh: 联合收割机
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们无法完成收割，因为我们的联合收割机陷在泥里了。

flashcards.definition: The part of the body of an animal or human which contains the brain, mouth and main sense organs.
flashcards.example: Be careful when you pet that dog on the head; it may bite.
flashcards.definitionZh: 动物或人类身体的一部分，包含大脑、口腔和主要感觉器官。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当你抚摸那只狗的头时要小心；它可能会咬人。

flashcards.definition: The caudal appendage of an animal that is attached to its posterior and near the anus.
flashcards.example: Most primates have a tail and fangs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 动物的尾部附属器，附着在其后部并靠近肛门。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大多数灵长类动物都有尾巴和尖牙。

flashcards.definition: To take an oath, to promise.
flashcards.example: This is the word SWEAR SWORE SWORN SWORE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发誓，许诺。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“SWEAR SWORE SWORN SWORE”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To possess a certain extent; to cover an amount of space.
flashcards.example: The desert extended for miles in all directions.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拥有一定程度；覆盖一定的空间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 沙漠向四面八方延伸数英里。

flashcards.definition: To such an extent or degree; to the same extent or degree.
flashcards.example: It's not as well made, but it's twice as expensive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 达到这样的程度；达到相同的程度或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然做工不太好，但价格却贵了一倍。

flashcards.definition: Confidence in or reliance on some person or quality.
flashcards.example: He needs to regain her trust if he is ever going to win her back.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对某人或品质的信心或依赖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果他想重新赢得她的信任，他就需要重新获得她的信任。

flashcards.definition: One who relies on another for support
flashcards.example: With two children and an ailing mother, she had three dependents in all.
flashcards.definitionZh: 依赖他人支持的人
flashcards.exampleZh: 她有两个孩子和一个生病的母亲，总共有三个家属。

flashcards.definition: Not affiliated with any political party.
flashcards.example: the independent candidate
flashcards.definitionZh: 不隶属于任何政党。
flashcards.exampleZh: 独立候选人

flashcards.definition: Prompt; on time.
flashcards.example: This is the word PUNCTUAL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 迅速的;准时。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“准时”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A line of objects, often regularly spaced, such as seats in a theatre, vegetable plants in a garden etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word ROW.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一排物体，通常间隔规则，例如剧院的座位、花园里的蔬菜植物等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是 ROW 这个词。

flashcards.definition: An oarsman; a rower.
flashcards.example: He is a good oar.
flashcards.definitionZh: 桨手；赛艇运动员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是一把好桨。

flashcards.definition: The thing desired or longed for.
flashcards.example: My dearest wish is to see them happily married.
flashcards.definitionZh: 所渴望或渴望的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我最大的愿望就是看到他们幸福地结婚。

flashcards.definition: Teaching or relating to the doctrine of idealism.
flashcards.example: the ideal theory or philosophy
flashcards.definitionZh: 教导或涉及唯心主义学说。
flashcards.exampleZh: 理想的理论或哲学

flashcards.definition: Of or relating to theory; abstract; not empirical.
flashcards.example: This is the word THEORETICAL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于理论或与理论有关的；抽象的;不是经验性的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是理论这个词。

flashcards.definition: Existing in reality, not just potentially; really acted or acting; occurring in fact.
flashcards.example: The actual government expenses dramatically exceed the budget.
flashcards.definitionZh: 现实中存在，而不仅仅是潜在的；真的演过或者演过；事实上正在发生。
flashcards.exampleZh: 政府的实际支出大大超出了预算。

flashcards.definition: (modal) In act or in fact; really; in truth; positively.
flashcards.example: Actually, I had nothing to do with that incident.
flashcards.definitionZh: （情态）实际上或实际上；真的;事实上；积极地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 事实上，我与那次事件无关。

flashcards.definition: An inspection or examination.
flashcards.example: I don't know if she will be there, but it's worth a check.
flashcards.definitionZh: 检查或检查。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不知道她是否会在那里，但值得检查一下。

flashcards.definition: The process of becoming different.
flashcards.example: The product is undergoing a change in order to improve it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 变得不一样的过程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为了改进该产品，正在进行更改。

flashcards.definition: The trunk of a dead tree, cleared of branches.
flashcards.example: They walked across the stream on a fallen log.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一棵枯树的树干，没有树枝。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们踩着一根倒下的木头走过小溪。

flashcards.definition: An open hearth for holding a fire at the base of a chimney.
flashcards.example: This is the word FIREPLACE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于在烟囱底部生火的平炉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是壁炉这个词。

flashcards.definition: Mutual; shared by more than one.
flashcards.example: The two competitors have the common aim of winning the championship.
flashcards.definitionZh: 相互的;被多个人共享。
flashcards.exampleZh: 两位选手有着共同的目标，那就是夺得冠军。

flashcards.definition: A mechanical device intended to make a task easier.
flashcards.example: Hand me that tool, would you?   I don't have the right tools to start fiddling around with the engine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种旨在使任务变得更容易的机械装置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 把那个工具递给我，好吗？   我没有合适的工具来开始摆弄引擎。

flashcards.definition: (usually in the negative) Money.
flashcards.example: I haven't got a bean.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常是负数）金钱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我连豆子都没有
